$Comment: Seasons of Orbis, the top rung of the ladder: a keepsake kept from every season this server runs,
and never from fewer than two.
MetaSelector writes no Needs, so it asks for every season it finds: each season whose yearly
keepsake carries the season_keepsake tag, any year's copy standing for it. AtLeast is the floor
under that count, so on a server running one season this waits for a second and never comes
before the first rung. A new season raises the count, and a player who already earned this keeps
it. A season a server owner switches off in calendar.json leaves the count, so this stays within
reach while at least two seasons are on. The description's number comes from TextArgs, so keep it
equal to AtLeast. It pays the title Seasons_Of_Orbis_Every_Season through the Title reward kind.
Keep this file's name: it is the id every player's progress on it is filed under. Filed under
Seasons with no subcategory, which is where the Almanac looks for its banner.
